navy-900.note: Sampled from the client's logo. Inherited, not chosen.

navy-700.note: Hover and pressed depth on navy surfaces. Never used for text.

blue-50.note: Hover fill. Light enough that navy text on it still passes AA, so hover never needs a text-colour change.

amber-800.note: 6.37:1 on amber-100. The triple exists so 'Menunggu Konfirmasi' is readable.

semanticLayer.note: DESIGN.md frontmatter carries primitives only, because a token may not reference another token in the same group. This is the layer a re-theme edits. Reference flows one direction: primitive to semantic to component.

display.purpose: Hero headline only. The single largest gesture on the page.

sm.purpose: State labels, helper text, field labels. Fixed at 14px on purpose.

xs.purpose: Captions and metadata. Fixed at 12px on purpose.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Resting cards. Reads as edge definition, not lift.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.note: The design target, not a fallback. Instagram in-app browser on mid-range Android.

borders.name: state
borders.purpose: Focus and error only. Weight change carries the state, so no state depends on colour alone.

borders.name: state-boundary-floor
borders.purpose: WCAG 1.4.11. When a border is a state's only visual signal it must clear 3:1 against its surroundings. red-300 on white is 1.90:1 and fails; red-800 is 8.31:1 and passes.

components.name: Slot Cell - Available
components.description: The signature component. Full-width row, time left, state right. One column is a hard constraint, not a preference.
components.css: .ds-slot { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; width:100%; min-height:56px; padding:16px; border-radius:2px; background:#FFFFFF; border:1px solid #2563EB; color:#011A43; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:1rem; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; transition:background 280ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), border-color 280ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), color 280ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-slot__time { font-family:Orbitron,system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:.01em; } .ds-slot__state { font-size:.875rem; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-slot:hover { background:#EFF6FF; } .ds-slot:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #2563EB; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Slot Cell - Selected
components.description: Selection holds nothing server-side. Only a successful POST does.
components.css: .ds-slot-selected { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; width:100%; min-height:56px; padding:16px; border-radius:2px; background:#2563EB; border:1px solid #2563EB; color:#FFFFFF; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:1rem; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; } .ds-slot-selected .ds-slot__time { font-family:Orbitron,system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:500; } .ds-slot-selected .ds-slot__state { font-size:.875rem; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-slot-selected:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #2563EB; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Slot Cell - Pending
components.description: The amber triple. 'Menunggu Konfirmasi' is 20 characters and is why the grid is one column.
components.css: .ds-slot-pending { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; width:100%; min-height:56px; padding:16px; border-radius:2px; background:#FEF3C7; border:1px solid #FCD34D; color:#92400E; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:1rem; text-align:left; cursor:not-allowed; } .ds-slot-pending .ds-slot__time { font-family:Orbitron,system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:500; } .ds-slot-pending .ds-slot__state { font-size:.875rem; white-space:nowrap; }

components.name: Date Pill
components.description: The only fully round shape in the system. Roundness signals that the row scrolls horizontally.
components.css: .ds-pill { flex:0 0 auto; min-width:64px; padding:8px 16px; border-radius:9999px; border:1px solid #E5E7EB; background:#FFFFFF; color:#011A43; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; text-align:center; cursor:pointer; transition:background 160ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-pill__day { display:block; font-size:.75rem; color:#6B7280; } .ds-pill__date { display:block; font-family:Orbitron,system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:.875rem; } .ds-pill:hover { background:#EFF6FF; border-color:#2563EB; } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #2563EB; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Navy fill. Active state shifts to Signal Blue so the press reads as interactive rather than as more navy.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height:48px; padding:0 24px; border-radius:2px; background:#011A43; color:#FFFFFF; border:1px solid transparent; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:1rem; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; transition:background 160ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#0A2E6B; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background:#1D4ED8; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #2563EB; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outline variant for the lower-priority action in a pair.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height:48px; padding:0 24px; border-radius:2px; background:transparent; color:#011A43; border:1px solid #011A43; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:1rem; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; transition:background 160ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:#F9FAFB; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #2563EB; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Input - Error
components.description: Error state pairs an 8.31:1 red-800 border with a red-100 fill, so the signal never depends on one property or on hue alone. An earlier draft used a red-300 border on a white field: 1.90:1, below the 3:1 WCAG 1.4.11 floor for non-text UI boundaries. Message ties to the field via aria-describedby.
components.html: Nomor tidak valid. Gunakan format 08xx atau 62xx.
components.css: .ds-field { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-label { font-size:.875rem; font-weight:500; color:#011A43; } .ds-input { height:48px; padding:0 12px; border-radius:2px; border:1px solid #E5E7EB; background:#FFFFFF; color:#011A43; font-family:inherit; font-size:1rem; } .ds-input--error { border:2px solid #991B1B; background:#FEE2E2; } .ds-input:focus { outline:2px solid #2563EB; outline-offset:2px; border-color:#2563EB; } .ds-err { font-size:.875rem; color:#991B1B; }

narrative.northStar: Not yet established — art direction is Phase 1b task 1 and has not been decided.
narrative.overview:
What is settled is the world's polarity. bataskotapoint.com is a binding reference as an anti-reference: dark, neon, saturated. Arena Player is its inverse — light, clean, blue-and-white, with whitespace treated as a material rather than as leftover room. Navy #011A43 is sampled from the client's own logo, so the palette is inherited, not invented.

The system's personality comes from a deliberate tension: Orbitron is a wide, geometric, athletic display face, and it sits on near-sharp geometry and generous white space. That combination is what keeps a booking utility from reading as a generic form, without a single decorative flourish being added. The one fully-round shape in the entire system is the date pill, and its roundness is functional.

Density is low by intent. The primary visitor is a team captain on a 375px Android inside the Instagram in-app browser, mid-conversation in another chat, deciding fast for eight to twelve people. Speed of comprehension outranks completeness of information everywhere the two conflict.
keyCharacteristics: Light and blue-white, never dark — the anti-reference is binding
Oversized Orbitron display against Inter body; no third face
Near-sharp corners throughout; exactly one round shape, and it means something
Status is a colour triple, never a single hue
Navy-tinted shadows only; black shadows read as dirt on a blue-white page
Whitespace is the layout device, not a shortage of content

rules.name: The Three-Layer Rule
rules.body: Reference flows one direction only: primitive to semantic to component. No component file contains a hex code, and no component reaches past its own layer for a raw value. Re-theming touches the semantic layer and nothing else.

rules.name: The Status-Is-Information Rule
rules.body: A booking state the user cannot read is a booking state they will get wrong. No status may be expressed as a single hue, and no status label may fall below AA.

rules.name: The Fluid-Not-Stepped Rule
rules.body: The scale runs a 1.25 ratio at 375px growing to 1.5 at 1440px via clamp(). There are no breakpoint jumps anywhere in the type system.

rules.name: The Fixed-Small Rule
rules.body: sm and xs deliberately do not scale. Shrinking a caption below 14px on mobile is an accessibility failure, and growing it on desktop makes it stop reading as secondary.

rules.name: The Tight-Display Rule
rules.body: Orbitron takes tighter leading than Inter or it reads as loose: 1.1 display, 1.25 headings, 1.6 body. Never apply body leading to Orbitron.

rules.name: The Two-Scroll Rule
rules.body: The order section must be reachable within one to two scrolls at 375px. The hero is capped at 100svh, not vh, because in-app browsers report vh incorrectly.

rules.name: The Horizontal-Containment Rule
rules.body: The date row scrolls with overscroll-behavior-x: contain, so a sideways swipe never bounces the page underneath it.

rules.name: The Tinted-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are navy-tinted, never neutral black. A black shadow on a blue-white page reads as dirt rather than as depth.

rules.name: The One-Round-Shape Rule
rules.body: Nothing but the date pill is fully round. The moment a second element takes the pill radius, the date row stops meaning 'this scrolls' and becomes just another style.

rules.name: The Visible-Unavailable Rule
rules.body: Disabled cells stay visible and legibly labelled. An organiser needs to see that 18.00 is taken, not wonder why the list skips it.

rules.name: The Focus-Is-Required Rule
rules.body: Focus rings are restyled, never removed. Keyboard operability is a Phase 3 Definition-of-Done item, not a styling preference.

rules.name: The Visible-Boundary Rule
rules.body: When a border is a state's only visual signal it must clear 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). red-300 on a white field computes to 1.90:1 and fails; the error state pairs a red-800 border at 8.31:1 with a red-100 fill so the signal survives both the contrast floor and colour-blindness.

dos: Do keep every reference flowing primitive to semantic to component. A hex code in a component file is a defect.
Do express every booking status as a surface + border + text triple that passes AA at the stated ratio.
Do route every animation through lib/motion.ts. GSAP has no built-in prefers-reduced-motion handling, so a direct gsap.to() in a component is banned.
Do animate transform and opacity only, and reserve space before animating in. No CLS.
Do keep the hero LCP element as text or logo, never an image.
Do tint shadows navy at low alpha.
Do let the date pill be the only fully round shape in the system.
donts: Don't go dark, neon, or saturated. The anti-reference is binding, and this is the one direction the client has ruled out by name.
Don't render a price anywhere. Pricing is an unresolved client decision.
Don't turn the slot grid into 2 or 3 columns. The 20-character state label does not fit, and truncating it destroys the information the cell exists to carry.
Don't add a third typeface, or apply body leading to Orbitron.
Don't load fonts from a CDN link in production — next/font is load-bearing for the no-CLS guarantee.
Don't use black shadows, or add a shadow where a hairline and a tonal band already separate two surfaces.
Don't add a second animation runtime beside GSAP, a Lottie file over 100KB, or an autoplaying video unless the Phase 1b hero-video gate passed.
Don't animate layout properties (width, height, top, left).
Don't invent art direction here. It is Phase 1b task 1 and belongs to that task.
Don't let a border be a state's only visual signal unless it clears 3:1. Pair it with a fill.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow above a heading. Where the small label holds real information (Layer 1, Layer 2), fold it into the heading instead of setting it as a separate uppercase line.
